Thank you so much for Appwrite! The community on Discord is very helpful and the self hosting guide is great. Very unlike my terrible experience with Supabase who seem to do their best to cripple the self hosted option.

Appwrite is written in PHP... AppWrite doesn't yet have their Cloud version, so they aren't ready to be a 'backend as a service'... It's not built on Postgres... it seems like the project doesn't move as fast as its competitor (primarily Supabase).

I've been looking into supabase for a long time... but after many months of keeping an eye on them, appwrite comes along and i'm instantly sold... Supabase is just fancy ui and marketing, while these guys seem the real deal.

Strictly speaking, if I spin up a droplet on DO and install Appwrite on it, it won't be a BAAS anymore... Sorry but 'self-host your own BAAS' is an oxymoron. IMO, developers who chose Firebase do not want to manage servers.
Looks real slick! ... nice to see Appwrite provides a containerized solution for that, should make distributed dev (and testing!) a lot easier. I'm gonna set aside some time today to play with this.
